purpose: Held-out real parallel-bar dip qualification. Visual labels and model-coverage floors are committed before Apple Vision is run on this candidate.

count_expectation.bar_reference_note: Manually reviewed centerline of the fixed near-side horizontal rail in the 640x360 prepared image, to the right of the selected hand; production uses the infinite line defined by this visible segment.

visual_review.method: Full source reviewed at 8 FPS from the prepared review derivative before any Apple Vision inference. The held-out interval is intentionally shortened to end after the third completed return to extension.
visual_review.observed_content: One athlete performs parallel-bar dips in a fixed landscape side view. The clip begins at a stable extended support, shows three complete extension-to-bent-to-extension cycles by 3.25 s, and the held-out trim ends before the source begins a fourth incomplete cycle.
limitations: Movement-cycle ground truth only; dip depth, lockout validity, body alignment and overall form are not qualified.
The image-plane elbow angle is an engineering signal, not a calibrated anatomical 3D angle.
This file must not be added to the Apple-Vision corpus until the dip counter redesign based on the separate JULLIAN W development clip is complete.
